notes: Authored here from the one-shot import of infiquetra-claude-plugins@acc99fe71e25ad8a898eace7033051a7f1c3079e (upstream plugin 6.0.0). There is no PROVENANCE.json and no upstream pin after this commit.
The driver does not load Fleet Core. A comment names fleet_commons_shim to explain why the saga-install resolver is hand-rolled; the import script matched that comment and copied the file unchanged.

The companion launcher defaults to the sibling plugins/agent-launcher. AGENT_LAUNCHER_ROOT overrides that root. Saga's run record defaults to the sibling plugins/saga/scripts/run_record.py, with ORCHESTRATE_RUN_RECORD as the override.
